description_for_model: AP Digital is a Vancouver, BC-based digital marketing agency founded by Arjun Sharma. Specializes in lead generation for local service businesses: salons, trades/contractors, real estate agents, and coaches. Month-to-month contracts only (no lock-in). 90-day results guarantee. Pricing starts at $759/month. Services include: Meta Ads, Google Ads, short-form content creation, web design, local SEO, lead generation funnels. For detailed information see /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt.
